reset_banks.contract: All53 outputs share one reset state and one-clock latency; no new payload or reset pipeline stage. Actual reset53 final-cell/formal/physical gates are mandatory.

boundary_links.reset_contract: Link8 uses an independent same-state/same-cycle fixed reset53 branch in R256; legacy uses its source branch. Payload isolated during reset, enabled on first following clock. No new payload cycle.

scope: Actual externally-fed programs using every selected final physical-functional leaf view and explicit fixed link/reset state. Zero-delay function only; actual combined geometry, PG and three RC/300MHz gates remain mandatory.
